name: Be Mine
source:
Somehow, a zombie breakout happened. But that's fine! You can survive by yourself! You spend most of the time alone either way, so it should be normal by now... Until you ran into someone you know, and they offered you shelter. Isn't that such a relief?

[From [url=https://milina-bryce.itch.io/be-mine]itch.io[/url]]
